title: Framed Digital Portrait
description: A painted depiction of a black smartphone with a colorful, textured frame containing a portrait of a bearded man in a dark hoodie standing against a teal background. The entire composition is set against a dark backdrop with visible brushstrokes and paint drips.
prompt: A realistic oil painting of a large black smartphone with a thick, textured, multicolored frame in yellow, red, and green, displayed against a dark background. Inside the phone screen is a portrait of a serious bearded man with dark hair wearing a black hoodie, standing in a dimly lit room with teal walls. Visible brushstrokes, paint drips, and artistic texture throughout the composition.
